title: Magnifying glass with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='62' y='62' width='16' height='32' rx='8' transform='rotate(-45 70 78)' fill='#e0a05a'/>
  <rect x='62' y='62' width='16' height='32' rx='8' transform='rotate(-45 70 78)' fill='none' stroke='#f7c98a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- rim -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='30' fill='#3fbfe8'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='30' fill='none' stroke='#9be6ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- lens -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='23' fill='#bfefff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='23' fill='none' stroke='#e8fbff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <path d='M28 30 A20 20 0 0 1 38 22' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#1b4a66'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#1b4a66'/>
  <path d='M32 48 Q42 56 52 48' stroke='#1b4a66' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='46' r='3' fill='#ff9db5'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='46' r='3' fill='#ff9db5'/>
</svg>
